It ensures that the coupling strength $K$ remains concentrated and undisturbed by the chaotic linear frequencies outside the boundary. Tethys acts as the active recirculation of the pump frequency $\Omega$, maintaining the continuous energy transfer required to sustain the stable phase lock.
